summary: Pulsenmore Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a press release dated August 19, 2026, regarding the adoption of its home ultrasound technology by Lis Maternity and Women's Hospital at Ichilov in Israel. This is an operational business development and customer adoption announcement, not a special situation. The filing describes the integration into pregnancy monitoring pathways and expansion into central Israel but includes no deal terms, transaction structure, or event affecting the company's ownership or capital structure. No special-situation category applies.
